description:
FILED s543h (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-22), found by the word-less eval-site probe of #2630 (scratch/s543h/p1/frag.pl row 3).  PRE-EXISTING: base 5e8b88c0 the same.

REPRODUCER (perl 5.40.3 | ./runpcl):
    use feature "evalbytes";
    my $x = 5; print evalbytes(q{$x}), "\n";                      # 5 | (empty)
    sub f { my $y = 7; evalbytes q{$y + 1} } print f(), "\n";     # 8 | 1

WHAT IT IS: `evalbytes` lowers to `(p-evalbytes STRING)` with NO site alist (and no feature list / visible prototypes), so the text sees none of the caller's lexicals -- every name is a package global.  `eval STRING` takes ExprToCL::_gen_eval_string_form (the alist, the #364 features, the s543h `our:` aliases); evalbytes is the same compile with a byte-string operand (perlfunc: "evalbytes ... behaves like eval EXPR except that it always parses its argument as a string of bytes").

FIX DIRECTION: route `evalbytes` through _gen_eval_string_form's inputs (the same three site inputs) and have p-evalbytes hand them to %p-eval-1; the scan's eval-word list (Parser2::_scan_eval_site_features, _is_string_eval_word) then counts an `evalbytes` word too, so the per-word publication (#2630 / #4821) reaches it.  BAR: the reproducer + a package-switching text + an `our` alias; the companion op/evalbytes.t one-file (7/2 today).


=== DONE (s543k) === (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-22/23; WIP 1 + WIP 8 of the s543k branch)
`evalbytes STRING` (the keyword: feature in force or CORE::evalbytes) takes the eval site's inputs through ExprToCL::_gen_eval_string_form (head p-evalbytes: the alist, the #364 features incl. `our:` aliases) and the eval node's context bind; cl p-evalbytes (s &optional lex-alist features) dies "Wide character in eval \"string\"" at the call on a char > 0xFF, then p-eval (one cache key: PCL reads every eval text as octets).  ONE eval-word list, Pl::PExpr::TokenUtils::eval_word (eval CORE::eval evalbytes CORE::evalbytes, with the bareword negatives ->WORD / WORD => / sub WORD / &WORD), asked by all 17 "a string eval is here" tests (listed in the s543k STOP.md / session log); CORE::eval had the alist but missed the same tests (a raw `:scalar` slot beside `CORE::eval q{$x}`).
Probes (s543k scratch/s543k/p1/probes.txt, 22 shapes): base 4a0fd0ec = perl on 6, tree on 21; the 22nd (an anon sub that does not name $k: perl's "not available") is the plain-eval answer too (DECIDED s504c).  Guard Pl/t/eval-capture-01.t eb_read eb_write eb_region eb_our eb_wide eb_feature (all fail on 4a0fd0ec).  Companion op/evalbytes.t 7/2 -> 8/1 ("evalbytes croaks on non-bytes" passes; the row left, "outside feature scope", is rule 9: re-caused in baselines/perl-suite-fails.tsv).  The first cut counted feature.pm-style `evalbytes =>` KEYS, which made experimental.pm's `_enable` capture refusal fire (feature-pragma-01.t 26 46): the negatives moved into the ONE predicate (WIP 8).

=== CLOSED (the reviewing session, 2026-11-24) === merged as MAIN-READY-110 26d0dac4 (s543k); the full gate on merged main 380 files / 12,490 rows PASS; the review probes 18 of 18 = perl (~/pcl-agent-scratch/s543/review/probes-1122/rk, leg-1124.log); no baseline row is keyed on this task.
